summary: InspireMD, Inc. filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and accompanying Series L common warrants on a best-efforts syndicated basis. Pricing is left blank (subject to completion, dated November 12, 2026); the last reported Nasdaq Capital Market price was $0.80 per share on November 11, 2026. Pre-funded warrants are priced at the share price less $0.0001 with a $0.0001 exercise price, offered to purchasers whose post-offering beneficial ownership would exceed 4.99% (or 9.99% at election). Underwriters received a 15% greenshoe. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, discount, and warrant terms for dilution and overhang, with no deal-arb angle.
